task.title: Create a flow that notifies a team about critical incidents
task.shortdesc: Build a flow in Workflow Studio that sends an email to the assignment group whenever someone creates an incident with a priority of 1 - Critical.

ul.li: The assignment group that should receive the email must have a group email address or at least one member with an email address.

context.p: Critical incidents need attention within minutes. Without automation, the assigned team learns about a new critical incident only when someone checks the queue. A record-triggered flow removes that delay by sending the notification the moment the incident is created.

step.cmd: On the flow properties form, fill in the fields.

stepresult.p: The flow editor opens with empty Trigger and Actions sections.

substep.cmd: Select Add a trigger, and then select Created.
In the Table field, select Incident [incident].
Add the condition Priority is 1 - Critical.
Under Actions, select Add an Action, Flow Logic, or SubflowAction.
Search for and select Send Email.
In the To field, drag the Assignment group data pill from the trigger record.
In the Subject field, enter Critical incident: and then drag the Number data pill after the text.
In the Body field, add the Short description and Caller data pills.

step.cmd: Test the flow before you activate it.

substep.cmd: Choose an existing incident with a priority of 1 - Critical, and then select Run Test.
Open the execution details and confirm that each step shows a status of Completed.

stepresult.p: The flow status changes to Active.

result.p: Each new incident with a priority of 1 - Critical now sends an email to its assignment group.

postreq.p: To change who receives the email or what it says, deactivate the flow, edit the Send Email action, and then activate the flow again.
